groups.title: A- Parent/Consumer Experience
items: Discovery UX like Zomato for classes: Visual browsing, cards, compare options, modern feel.
Remove forced pre-selection fields: Let users browse first, decide later.
Smart optional filters: Age, fees, distance, timing, category.
Auto detect location + easy manual switch
Trusted reviews from contacts: Huge trust lever.
Better onboarding flow: Quick onboarding + intent capture.

groups.title: Intelligence + Ecosystem
items: AI recommendation engine: Suggest best classes by child age, goals, location.
Community layer for parents: Reviews, forums, recommendations.
Hyperlocal city expansion engine: Mumbai → Pune → Bangalore etc.
Franchise / SaaS model: License platform to cities / activity networks.
